Three measured facts rejected it: (1) ZERO-DUPLICATION — its core competency (quality/factual errors in our published content) is already a recruited daily role: content-reviewer (Domain, D-r144-r1 lineage) audits published items against the measured truth baseline, and the r145-c truth-sweep + dedup-corrections machinery extends it; the external-reaction side on-chain is covered by audience-analyst (votes/replies/rshares). A vigil role would duplicate both 1:1. (2) ZERO-SIGNAL measured: real web searches for the footprint ("SAOS THE WEAVE steem" num=8, "headcorner steem account" num=8) returned 16/16 results ALL irrelevant (biomaterials papers, generic steem directory pages) — the public web index does not yet surface the network's footprint, so a vigil scout would measure zero for the foreseeable future. (3) The watch duty it could add (brand terms on the open web) is a 3-query slice, not a role. Re-visit condition: re-measure brand-term searches after the public content wave grows (>=1 relevant result for "SAOS THE WEAVE"/account-name queries) or when an external surface (non-Steem) mentions the network — then the watch graduates into a real role with its own port.
